title: Do graph entanglers help?
rationale: Compare graph-edge RZZ messages with no entanglers at depth 2. Both arms use the same number of validation-selected random parameter candidates. Set task=entanglement. Use seeds 0–4; five percentage points is the provisional positive-effect threshold. Use the triangle-count classical baseline. These two degree-matched graph families test expressivity only: permutations are not independent scientific samples or unseen topologies. Never claim general quantum superiority.

falsifiers.description: Mean treatment gain is below five percentage points

samples.description: Arm accuracies and held-out permutation predictions; only two graph topologies.
